message: instance `{instance}` overrides `{param}`, which module `{module}` declares as a `localparam` — a localparam is a module-internal constant and cannot be overridden
description: A `localparam` is not part of a module's interface. Its author declared it so that it could not be changed from outside.
actions: If it should be adjustable, declare it as a `parameter` in the module.
